provenance.aggregation: Area mean of 5x5 existing 4 m CTX prior samples; any unknown -> unknown; no filling
provenance.display_convention: Planetocentric latitude, east longitude; sphere radius 3396190 m
provenance.loss: Averages the upstream bilinear prior; smooths extremes, no native detail recovered
provenance.scientific_limit: Regional DEM average does not resolve rocks, paths or subcell hazards

source.adaptation_hash_format: sha256 of canonical JSON excluding adaptation_sha256; sorted keys, ASCII, compact, UTF-8
source.height_policy: CTX absolute elevations unchanged; HiRISE-derived origin_z_m ignored

layers.obstacles: No observed obstacle layer; False means no additional scenario obstacle, not physical absence
layers.risk: Unavailable; zeros disable additional penalty, not measured zero risk
layers.roughness: Unavailable; zeros disable additional penalty, not measured smoothness
layers.slope: Existing CORE gradient and edge slopes from this CTX crop; one-sided at crop boundaries

limitations: Real orbital terrain; CTX native 20 m information resampled upstream to 4 m, no new detail
Experimental prior-only planning with incomplete local knowledge, no local certification
Demonstration targets and agent parameters simulated, no science detection or physical/EVA validation
No HiRISE payload, joint validity mask, sensor or estimated/observed state used
source.package_integrity: verified SHA-256 against existing metadata; not an external signature
source.resampling_upstream: bilinear; CTX remains 20 m information on the 4 m computational grid

source.citation: Fergason et al. (2020), Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic, USGS.

source.source_window_hash_verification: recorded only; native source tile absent
source.validity_policy: CTX finite and not source nodata; unknown -> None -> CORE blocking; no fill
source.vertical_reference: source product MOLA topography / DeltaGeoid; no Earth datum conversion
